_comment: #3824: the master-realm settings that were configured by hand on the live realm and are not Keycloak defaults. --import-realm never touches master (it exists before the import runs), so provision-master-realm.sh applies this as a partial PUT after every fresh database. example.invalid is rendered with KEYCLOAK_PUBLIC_DOMAIN like apiary-realm.json. Besides these fields the script sets the webauthn-authenticator step of 'Browser - Conditional 2FA' to ALTERNATIVE, matching the apiary realm.
